facts.text: Texas Tech's Red Raider Guarantee requires entering freshmen to be Texas residents with a family adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less.

sources.title: Red Raider Guarantee | Financial Aid Home | Texas Tech
sources.quote: Must be an entering freshman. Must be eligible to complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) Must be a Texas resident. Must have a family adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less.
